pages.text: We see the Sun, Moon, stars and planets in the sky. These heavenly bodies are part of our neighbourhood in space.
The Sun gives us heat and light. The Earth moves around the Sun.
The Moon is Earth's natural satellite. It changes shape as seen from Earth.

topics.title: Our Sky Neighbourhood
topics.text: We see the Sun, Moon, stars and planets in the sky. These heavenly bodies are part of our neighbourhood in space.
topics.learning_goal: Students understand that the sky contains different heavenly bodies.

illustrations.caption: Children looking at the Sun, Moon, stars and planets in the sky.

topics.title: The Sun
topics.text: The Sun gives us heat and light. The Earth moves around the Sun.
topics.learning_goal: Students understand that the Sun gives heat and light and Earth moves around it.

topics.title: The Moon
topics.text: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite. It changes shape as seen from Earth.
topics.learning_goal: Students understand that the Moon is Earth's natural satellite and appears to change shape.

illustrations.caption: Different shapes of the Moon seen from Earth.
